name: claude-custom-skills
description: Claude Code skills: plugin token-cost audit, approval-gated disk cleanup and Gmail organization, and a session-journal + worktree-per-ticket workflow.

plugins.name: context-audit
plugins.description: Rank enabled plugins and MCP servers by always-on token cost against real usage, then apply the cut list.

plugins.name: disk-cleanup
plugins.description: Scan every readable volume, rank storage biggest-first, and remove only what you approve by name. The scanner cannot delete.

plugins.name: gmail-organize
plugins.description: Migrate a Gmail mailbox to one label convention, sort the backlog and install filters through the gws CLI, one approved batch at a time, with undo.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Per-branch session journals, conversation capture, standup reports, and a worktree-per-ticket lifecycle that share one docs/custom-agents/ folder.

plugins.name: transcribe-video
plugins.description: Transcribe or caption a video or audio file with the local OpenAI Whisper CLI.

plugins.name: gov-job-finder
plugins.description: Find open Philippine government vacancies in a region, filtered to tech and any-degree roles.
